title: Number of Americans age 100 or older

source.name: US centenarian population estimates and projections
source.publisher: Pew Research Center, based on U.S. Census Bureau data and projections

notes: Census Bureau estimates: about 2,300 Americans were 100+ in 1950; about 37,000 in 1990; an estimated 101,000 in 2024. Census Bureau projects the total will reach about 422,000 by 2054, more than quadrupling in 30 years.
